lines.t: All aboard, all aboard!
Toot that trumpet, let the Spirit reign!
This ain’t no ordinary train—
It’s the Trumpet Soul Train!
Steppin’ on the platform, hearts open wide,
We're rollin’ through the rhythm where love can’t hide.
Voices liftin’ higher, truth in every tone,
The Word is our conductor, takin’ us home.
Ride that trumpet soul train, HalleluYah sound!
Joy in the music, blessings all around.
Every beat’s a message, every note divine,
We’re groovin’ for the Kingdom, leavin’ doubt behind!
Shinin’ shoes and smilin’, movin’ in time,
Every soul’s a singer, every word a sign.
Light from the heavens, flowin’ through the groove,
Spirit’s in the rhythm—watch His people move!
Clap your hands, the volumes of truth
is alive!
The trumpet calls, awaken and rise!
From city streets to the holy plains,
We’re ridin’ free on the Trumpet Soul Train!
Ride that trumpet soul train, Hallelujah sound!
Joy in the music, blessings all around.
Every beat’s a message, every note divine,
We’re groovin’ for the Kingdom, leavin’ doubt behind!
Keep on singin’, let the good Word play,
The trumpet’s callin’—we’re rollin’ God’s way!
On the Trumpet Soul Train, faith’s our refrain,
Glory to His name, on the Trumpet Soul Train!
